name: flagship-frutiger-aero-2027
description: Flagship theme frutiger-aero-2027 (cmux#47278), with its type set as settings for builds before the theme-file font keys.

files.themes/frutiger-aero-2027.json:
// Frutiger Aero 2027: the glossy sky-and-water optimism of the late 2000s, rebuilt on liquid glass.
// Clear glass panes over a cloud study, sky-blue accent, aqua and leaf-green tones, fast springy
// motion. Copy it to ~/.config/cmux/themes/frutiger-aero-2027.json (yours wins over this one), edit
// and save: the running app repaints at once, no relaunch.
{
  "name": "Frutiger Aero 2027",
  "description": "Clear glass over a bright sky; sky blue, aqua and leaf green, glossy and quick.",

  // The terminal theme and its colors.
  "appearance.theme": "TokyoNight Day",
  "colors": {
    "background": "#eef7ff",
    "foreground": "#0b2a44",
    "cursor": "#007fc4",
    "selection": "#c6e3fa",
    "accent": "#007fc4",
    "0": "#0b2a44",
    "1": "#d6334a",
    "2": "#2f9e2f",
    "3": "#c98a00",
    "4": "#007fc4",
    "5": "#8a55c9",
    "6": "#00a3b4",
    "7": "#d3e6f5",
    "8": "#5a7a94",
    "9": "#f0566a",
    "10": "#5cc23a",
    "11": "#f0b31e",
    "12": "#36a9f0",
    "13": "#b07ae8",
    "14": "#22c8d8",
    "15": "#ffffff"
  },
  "appearance.accent": "theme",
  "appearance.saturation": 1.15,

  // The sky behind clear glass: the most see-through of the flagships.
  "appearance.background": "dahl-cloud-study",
  "appearance.backgroundOpacity": 0.62,
  "appearance.backgroundBlur": "glass-clear",
  "appearance.glassTransparency": 0.55,
  "appearance.wallpaperTint": true,

  // Floating glass panes; an icy-blue sidebar of cards.
  "appearance.chromeStyle": "floating",
  "appearance.sidebarSurface": "separate",
  "appearance.surfaces.sidebar.color": "#d9ecfb",
  "appearance.surfaces.sidebar.opacity": 0.62,
  "sidebar.sectionLook": "card",
  "appearance.surfaces.tabBar.color": "#d9ecfb",
  "appearance.surfaces.tabBar.opacity": 0.55,
  "appearance.surfaces.terminal.color": "#eef7ff",
  "appearance.surfaces.terminal.opacity": 0.8,
  "appearance.surfaces.agentPane.color": "#eef7ff",
  "appearance.surfaces.agentPane.opacity": 0.84,
  "appearance.surfaces.newTabPage.color": "#eef7ff",
  "appearance.surfaces.newTabPage.opacity": 0.4,
  "appearance.surfaces.home.color": "#eef7ff",
  "appearance.surfaces.home.opacity": 0.4,
  "browser.omnibar.glass": "clear",

  // Type: Folio's Hanken Grotesk, Menlo in the terminals.
  "agentPane.display.font.ui": "hanken",
  "terminal.fontFamily": "Menlo",
  "terminal.fontSize": 13,

  // Motion: springy color changes and a sky-blue arc.
  "appearance.statusIndicator.style": "arc",
  "appearance.statusIndicator.color": "#007fc4",
  "appearance.colorTransition.curve": "spring",
  "appearance.colorTransition.duration": 350,

  "appearance.density": "comfortable"
}
